WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS baseline_value
  FROM site_averages
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_faces) AS status_average
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.avg_faces,
    b.baseline_value,
    sta.status_average
  FROM site_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  INNER JOIN status_averages sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat
  WHERE sa.avg_faces > sta.status_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_faces) AS average_of_kept,
  AVG(avg_faces - baseline_value) AS exceed_baseline_avg,
  AVG(avg_faces - status_average) AS exceed_status_avg
FROM kept_sites
